description: This file defines API endpoints for user management in a FastAPI application, including creating users, listing users with optional search, and retrieving user details by ID. It utilizes SQLAlchemy for database interactions with asynchronous sessions.

methods.name: UserRead create_user(payload: UserCreate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Creates a new user after checking for email uniqueness, returns the created UserRead object.

methods.name: List[UserRead] list_users( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional case-insensitive search on email or name"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive search query.

methods.name: UserRead get_user(user_id: str, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their ID; raises a 404 error if not found.

ctags.name: create_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_user(payload: UserCreate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)) -> User/

ctags.name: get_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_user(user_id: str, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)) -> UserRead:$/

ctags.name: list_users
ctags.signature: ( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional case-insensitive search on email or name"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), )
